intro: {{nameA}} is a private engineering college in {{cityA}}, and {{nameB}} is a public Anna University campus in the same city. This page compares the recorded {{course}} fees we hold, and it flags what is missing, using official sites opened in {{year}}.

TRP Engineering College vs University College of Engineering, BIT Campus is a private-versus-public choice in Tiruchirappalli. Both are listed with TNEA. We have a year tuition only for TRP, and no recent placement row for either side.

sections.heading: TRP Engineering College vs UCE BIT Campus for B.Tech / B.E.: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose University College of Engineering, BIT Campus if you want a public Anna University campus with a wider listed branch set, after you confirm the official TNEA fee, which is missing from our table.
Choose TRP Engineering College if you want a private college B.E. at the recorded year tuition of ₹50,000, after you check the current fee circular and affiliation details.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what is missing
paragraphs: For TRP Engineering College we hold ₹50,000 as tuition for one year across civil, computer science, ECE, EEE and mechanical engineering. That is a year figure, not a confirmed four-year official total, and we have not multiplied it.
University College of Engineering, BIT Campus has no B.Tech fee row here. A blank cell is not a free seat. Use the official Anna University or TNEA fee notice for that campus.
Tamil Nadu government-quota fees are often lower than private management fees, but we will not invent a BIT Campus figure that we do not hold.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: We have no B.Tech placement row for 2020 or later on either side, so this page cannot quote an average or highest package.
Ask both placement cells for a recent official report. Do not fill the gap with unofficial figures.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Both colleges are listed with TNEA. Follow the official Tamil Nadu engineering counselling process for 2026, including the current cutoff and quota rules.

BIT Campus lists a wider set of programmes on this page, including biotechnology, information technology, petrochemical and pharmaceutical technology, plus core engineering. TRP lists five core B.E. branches.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are recorded in Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu, so a local student can visit them without leaving the city.
BIT Campus is a public Anna University college. TRP is a private engineering college. The campus size, fees notice and peer group will not feel the same.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick University College of Engineering, BIT Campus if a public Anna University seat is the priority, and you have the official TNEA fee in hand.
Pick TRP Engineering College if the recorded ₹50,000 year tuition and the five listed B.E. branches fit your plan, after you recheck the official circular.
Because placements are missing, let college type, branch and the official fee decide this comparison.
